text:
Lincoln Financial Field mepere na August 2003 dị ka ebe egwuregwu bọọlụ e wuru kpọmkwem, na-anọchi Veterans Stadium na mpaghara egwuregwu South Philadelphia dị na 1020 Pattison Avenue. E wuru ya na ego mbụ nke US$512 million ma chepụta ya site n'aka NBBJ na Agoos Lovera Architects, ya na injinia ihe owuwu site n'aka Ove Arup & Partners.

Site na mmeghe ya ọ bụla ụlọ nke Philadelphia Eagles na NFL na Temple Owls na NCAA football, ma na-anabata egwuregwu soccer. Ọrụ abụọ dị ka ụlọ gridiron na ebe egwuregwu bọọlụ mgbe ụfọdụ akpụziwo njirimara ebe ahụ n'ime ihe karịrị afọ iri abụọ, na-akwado ya dị ka otu n'ime amaụlọ ndị a ma ama nke obodo ya.

Isi isi nke akụkọ ebe ahụ bụ mmemme nchekwa ya. Nrụzigharị 2013, nke ruru ihe dị ka US$125 million, gbakwụnyere ihe dị ka panel anyanwụ 11,000 na turbines ikuku 14, na-emepụta ihe dị ka otu ụzọ atọ — 30% — nke ike ebe ahụ. Nrụnye ahụ mere ebe ahụ bụ ihe atụ pụrụ iche nke ike mmegharị dị na saịtị n'etiti amaụlọ America ndị bụ isi.

Ebe ahụ nwekwara ndekọ bọọlụ mba ụwa dị ukwu, ebe emela egwuregwu otu Copa America Centenario na 2015 CONCACAF Gold Cup ikpeazụ, nke Mexico meriri Jamaica 3-1 na July 26, 2015. Maka 2026 World Cup a gbanwere aha ebe ahụ ka ọ bụrụ Philadelphia Stadium ma na-anabata egwuregwu isii, gụnyere egwuregwu Round of 16 na July 4 — isi nke asọmpi nke na-etinye amaụlọ e chepụtara na mbụ maka gridiron n'etiti egwuregwu ụwa, yana ikike nhazi World Cup nke 68,324.
